approval_source.question_set: Measurements added to the metric set (monitoring M3)

decisions.question: D12-Q02
decisions.rule: The core metric set (metrics v1, decision 2, P01 27 September 2026) gains, without per-peer or per-account labels: in the application, transactions by kind and result, gas used, validator evidence applied, root controls committed by kind, signature verifications by scheme and result, and signature verification time by scheme; in the engine, the PQC signing time of votes and proposals. Fees, issuance, supply, staking and penalties stay the supply buckets; restarts, host resources and RPC latency come from the monitor job (monitoring v1).

does_not_authorize: any run on a real host
